sections.A: Hamstrings ran ke peeche teen muscles hain. Inki chot aksar tez daurne (sprint) ya zyada stretch se hoti hai.
sections.B: Daurte ya stretch karte waqt ran ke peeche achanak tez dard aur khinchne ka ehsaas.
sections.C: Chot ke waqt kya kar rahe the (sprint, kick, stretch) aur dard muscle mein hai ya kooleh ki haddi ke paas.
sections.D: Neel, sujan, chaal dekhein, aur muscle aur tendon dabayein.
sections.E: Tests tear ka saheeh size nahi batate; yeh jagah, shiddat aur progress batate hain.
sections.F: Muscle strain, proximal hamstring tendon ki chot aur kamar se aata dard ka farq table mein hai.
sections.G: Achanak shadeed dard, bara neel, haath se mehsoos hone wala gap aur chal na sakna: tendon haddi se ukhar gaya ho sakta hai, urgent refer.
sections.H: Avulsion ya bohat bara tear ka shak ho to refer. Warna jaldi load shuru.
sections.I: Soft tissue kaam, aur nerve irritation ho to neural mobilisation.
sections.J: Dard ijazat de to foran load shuru karein aur din ginne ke bajaye dard-free criteria se aage barhein. Aakhir mein tez daurna aur eccentric exercise.
sections.K: Shuru mein thand aur compression optional.
sections.L: Avulsion screen karein, chot aur waqt ki range samjhayein, jaldi load shuru, phir daurne ki taraf aur khel par wapsi ke criteria.
sections.M: Kaam mein dard, dabane par dard, SLR aur knee extension range, taaqat aur daurne ki raftaar dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 23 saal ka footballer sprint karte hue ruk gaya kyunki ran ke peeche dard hua. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: avulsion aur nerve ke masle rule out karein, phir jaldi dheere dheere load.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
